### D-21569: Japanese Parenthetical Fragments in `default`

Screened the 65,135 active default rows for Japanese cells whose entire
text is parenthesized, matching the requested `;(...)` shape. Classified
113 candidates by English meaning rather than punctuation alone: 79
condition/weapon/target/location fragments, three short spawn-action
labels, one purpose fragment, and 30 English-parenthesized asides,
comments, or status labels. The 30 already had corresponding Korean
parentheses and were retained. Of the 83 short fragments, six Korean
labels already had the requested form; 77 cells were corrected.

Followed Japanese's compact qualifier form, including `(야간)` and
`(주간)`, and made target/weapon fragments suitable for postposed use.
Normalized the 22 Familiar/Upgrade/Mastery level labels to 사역마,
사역마 강화 and 사역마 숙련도, preserving every level and qualifier.
Used the official Korean manual's 셉터 for Sceptres. At
default:45697, distinguished parrying from ordinary blocking using
default:41891/51696/52709 and Japanese パリィ中. At
default:10487, the existing same-file translation `Sleight of Hand` =
`손재주` at default:16773 supports `(손재주 생성)`. At default:26982,
English says `to stun enemies` while Japanese instead says `vs. paralyzed
enemies`; English meaning controls, and only the Korean fragment's outer
parentheses were added. At default:58894, Japanese refers to undamaged
boots, unlike English's unworn boots; retained the current English-led
Korean meaning and recorded the source conflict without resolving it.
Existing keys and dispositions were not reopened or recounted.

## Preliminary Language Scan

- This is read-only preparatory work, not the independent Reviewer pass and
  not approval to edit translations.
- Expanded combined-name follow-up is now in progress because `base` and
  `affix` compose into displayed item names. Eleven rounds cover `base` IDs
  0-1099 (1,100/4,844 rows) and `affix` IDs 0-109 (640/3,451 variants).
  Japanese source wording is used closely for affix slot/variant structure;
  English remains the meaning authority and Chinese is supporting evidence.
  Findings include the `Crushing`/`Sundering` meaning collapse, the
  `Threadbare Circlet` equipment-type concern, and the `Galvanizing` effect
  ambiguity. Round 5 flags the postposed `of Cold` and `of Lightning Shield`
  genitives as awkward when attached after Korean base names, alongside
  proper-name, item-category, and terminology questions. Round 6 additionally
  flags the stacked genitive at `of Storm's Rage`, postposed possessive forms,
  and recurring item-term questions including `Ebony Limb` and `Silkfarmer`.
  Round 7 adds `of Skill`/`of Flurry` slot concerns, adjective-form alignment,
  and `List of the Executed`/`Chainmail Brace` meaning checks. Resume at
  `base` IDs 900-999 and `affix` IDs 90-99. Round 8 added the postposed
  Prophecy/Accuracy/Radiance/Bloodshed forms, the official `Detect Hidden`
  term, and related item/name questions. Round 9 adds `House of Vengeance`,
  `Gem of Tempest's Vengeance`, and equipment/name-relation questions.
  Round 10 rechecks previously scanned IDs, carries forward Rathir, Ambient,
  House of Seasons, and Bolgans' Bane questions, and checks whole-name
  register, postposed relations, and parenthetical placement. Round 11
  carries forward Kite Shield, Merchant's Command, Gallows Bloom, House of
  Pride, and recipe-tier questions; it also records the `Frame` meaning
  conflict, `Jail Cell` category loss, and Dirge-name consistency. Resume at
  `base` IDs 1100-1199 and `affix` IDs 110-119.
  Continue through both full resources before applying the literary/
  figurative/satirical localization criterion across `default`. See the
  `combined-name-review-...-round*.md` reports. This is separate follow-up
  coverage, not final approval or a change to first-pass totals.
- The combined-name reports are slot-aware linguistic checks against locale
  source forms. The inspected loot/item-set assets are opaque binaries; no
  human-readable item-specific base/affix pairing table or runtime-rendered
  complete item name has been verified. Do not present hypothetical
  assembled examples as observed game output.
- Coverage reconciled through 2026-10-09: `base` IDs 0-4843 (4,844 rows),
  `affix` IDs 0-585 (3,451 target variants, first pass and fallback
  cross-check complete), and
  `default` IDs 0-65134 (65,135 rows), totaling 73,430 of 73,430
  rows/variants. The 1,428 preliminary reports comprise 57 `base`, 60
  contiguous `affix` batches plus one fallback follow-up, and 1,310
  `default` batches. Direct
  audit-directory counts were used to reconcile prior inconsistent report
  subtotals; the latest `default` batch is IDs 65101-65134, completing the
  contiguous `default` scan.
  It records Ascendant's Vengeance, the specimen test, the cost variable,
  Foes' Hearth, Servant, scrivener, conscripts, sparring, Oathblade,
  Varani, and Three Swords. Keys/order, newline counts, and runtime
  variable match; `$VMC_NQD.cost_mine$` is preserved. Findings remain
